title: semele androgyna
intro: Semele androgyna, commonly known as the golden lotus or golden sambar, is a plant species native to India and Southeast Asia, known for its unique, golden flowers. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating symptoms of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The health benefits of Semele androgyna include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to loosen and clear mucus from the lungs, and its anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to soothe and calm irritated tissues. The bioactive constituents of Semele androgyna include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
